what: Use the identified separate GL-MT3000 Beryl AX for the portable Jetson/KVM LAN; connect Jetson Ethernet first while preserving the working KVM path.
why: The kit needs a repeatable local network that can travel without repurposing the home router.
details: The separate router is GL-MT3000 Beryl AX. The user confirms Jetson Ethernet is connected to its LAN port. The Mac joined Beryl Wi-Fi and received 192.168.8.174; the current 192.168.8.1 admin page identifies GL-MT3000, distinct from the prior home GL-MT6000 at that address on the home network. Internet and the KVM at 192.168.2.2 remain reachable through Mac sharing. Beryl admin login, Jetson DHCP/SSH and the final portable topology remain pending. No router configuration has changed, and the home router remains unchanged. No Wi-Fi credentials are recorded.
